mentions.name: Lorepanic
mentions.description: An AI-powered search engine and specialized ChatGPT-style assistant for Dungeons & Dragons, paired with a Discord bot that auto-records game sessions and delivers transcripts with AI-generated summaries when finished. The builder is exploring ways to make the service free to run without heavy personal costs.
mentions.audience: A tabletop role-playing groups and D&D players who need rules/lore lookups and session notes.
mentions.source_excerpt: I continue working on my search engine for Dungeons and Dragons, basically making a specialized chatgpt for D&D + a discord bot that autorecords sessions and sends you the transcript & AI summary when it's done.

evidence.value: I continue working on my search engine for Dungeons and Dragons, basically making a specialized chatgpt for D&D + a discord bot that autorecords sessions and sends you the transcript & AI summary when it's done.
